Plugin.Name: Windows Dynamic Disks
Plugin.Description: Read Windows dynamic disks (LDM) on Unraid: the simple, spanned, striped and mirrored volumes Windows builds across several disks, which Unassigned Devices can't mount.[br][br] Features:[br] - Finds dynamic disks on its own and shows each volume on the Main page, under Unassigned Devices[br] - Simple, spanned and striped volumes on MBR or GPT disks; mirrored volumes read from one copy, even with a disk missing[br] - Mounts under /mnt/disks, read-only by default; read-write on request[br] - Optional SMB share per volume, public or per user[br] - ldmctl command-line tool[br][br] RAID-5 volumes are not supported (Unraid's kernel has no dm-raid). ReFS can't be read on Linux.[br] Requires Unraid 7.0.0 or later.
